name: Dan Claudino
bio:
Dan Claudino (born October 7, 1996) is a Brazilian actor, performer, director, and voice actor. He began his career as a child actor, making his stage debut in Federico García Lorca's O Idílio de Carvoeirinha (2009). Claudino went on to play notable roles in various productions, including Airton in Tem Alguém em Casa? (2022), Francisco in 11 Homens e 1 Ônibus (2026), Jean-Luc Fornier in O Grande Furto Paulista (2026), and Detective Bones—a puppet he operated and voiced—in O Assassino do Boom / The Boom Killer (2026). Furthermore, he wrote, directed, and starred as Parafuso in the film Eu, a Kombi e a Garotinha que Encontrei no Meio do Caminho (2026). His screen credits also include Flores Secas (2017), dEus (2022), Eco (2024), Amor à Terceira Vista (2022), A Última Oração (2025), and Interstício (2026).

On television, Claudino appeared in TV Gazeta's miniseries Extremos da Cidade (2014). He has portrayed characters in numerous theater productions, such as Mistério na Sala de Ensaio e Outras Histórias (2013), Aquela Água Toda (2014), the award-winning Histórias de bobos, bocós, burraldos e paspalhões (2014–2016), 4.48 (2016–2017), O Balcão / The Balcony (2017), O Último Carro (2018), À Deriva (2019), and Pule ou Ocorrência às 4h48 (2019-2020).

Beyond acting, Claudino has directed music videos, including Sonhoz (2019), Olhar (2019), and Rosto Desfigurado (2024), and authored the horror book Entre Nós, Um Assassino.

credits.overview: Ashton chats with his mother on FaceTime, when he is surprised by a masked presence inside his home.

credits.title: Ecos do Medo
credits.overview: Alone in a shadowy, chaotic apartment, Carlos is haunted by guilt and past trauma. As night deepens, reality unravels and ghostly whispers return. Trapped in fear, he faces a presence that may be more than a creature of his fractured mind.

credits.title: Eu, a Kombi e a Garotinha que Encontrei no Meio do Caminho
credits.overview: Marcela decides to hit the road after an encounter with a fortune teller. Along the way, she meets Lia, and the journey takes on new meaning. Amid changing landscapes and encounters, they embark on a path that changes their lives.

credits.title: The Boom Killer
credits.overview: A great tragedy occurs during the filming of a movie. In an unexpected twist, the renowned Detective Bones takes on the case, as he can sniff out that something isn’t right.

credits.title: O Grande Furto Paulista
credits.overview: Pierrot Dubois, an esteemed French thief, leads his partners Amélie and Jean-Luc on a daring mission: to steal a valuable diamond from a vault in São Paulo's largest bank.

credits.title: 11 Men and 1 Bus
credits.overview: Eight men, on their way to a film set, get stranded on a random road when the bus they were on breaks down. Each reacts to the event in a different way. Interpersonal conflicts dictate how and when they will manage to escape the situation.

credits.title: The Last Prayer
credits.overview: Caio is a deeply religious young man, living in the shadow of his brother, Alberto. While Alberto challenges norms and embraces life, Caio feels trapped by his beliefs. In a moment of desperation, Caio murders Alberto and stages his death as a suicide, convincing himself that he acted in God’s name.

credits.title: Butterfly
credits.overview: Lelê deals with the loss of someone close, navigating through pain and grief until finding new meaning and peace.

credits.title: Street Cinemas
credits.overview: Explore the significance and impact of São Paulo’s iconic street cinemas. The documentary shows how these venues have shaped the city’s cultural experience and become enduring gathering spots for the local community.

credits.title: Echo
credits.overview: Gabriel is a depressed young man living a reclusive and lonely life, shaken by memories of a very turbulent past. credits.overview: A Whey Protein was stolen inside a fraternity of boys. An investigation begins to discover the real person responsible for the theft.

credits.title: Is There Anyone Home?
credits.overview: For the first time, Airton lives far from his sister, Ana Luísa. Despite the distance, the siblings talk whenever possible. However, a simple joke leads Airton to question whether there is anyone, besides him, inside his new home.

credits.overview: After his parents’ difficult divorce, Frederico decides to move to São Paulo to live with his mother and study engineering, a childhood dream. However, Fred begins to see himself differently; his best friend starts dating the girl of his dreams, and he is forced to confront his greatest problem: himself.
